name: productpanda
description: Ask what your product is, where users get stuck, what the engineering risks are, how you compare with competitors, and what changed on the default branch. It can also write a skill set for the product into the repository. The server is read only.

PRODUCTPANDA_MCP_URL.title: MCP URL
PRODUCTPANDA_MCP_URL.description: Product Panda MCP endpoint. Leave the default for production. For a local API use http://localhost:3000/mcp.

PRODUCTPANDA_MCP_KEY.title: MCP key
PRODUCTPANDA_MCP_KEY.description: Read only key from Product Panda Settings, MCP. It starts with mcp_ and is shown once when created.
